newsitem.title: USA: SCB to provide year 2000 services to AT&T.
newsitem.headline: SCB to provide year 2000 services to AT&T.

text.p: SCB Computer Technology Inc on Monday said it is one of four firms picked by AT&T Corp to find and fix any millenium bug problems in the telecommunications giant's computers.
SCB did not give financial details of the agreement with AT&T, but it did note that the pact extends through 1998 and that it could generate "multi-million dollar" revenues.

Many older computers and software programs, unable to process two-digit dates correctly after December 31, 1999, could crash on January 1, 2000, while many other will think the date is Jauary 1, 1900.

SCB said the agreement calls for it to be a "repair partner," responsible for assessing AT&T's computer code and bringing a significant portion of the code into compliance with Year 2000 processing requirements.
In the release, AT&T said it hopes to meet year 2000 compliance by the end of 1998.
